extracted.name: Lemon and Peach Brandy Sauce
extracted.description: It's different with sweet and sour lemon and peach flavors.
instruction_lines: Add butter and sugar to a hot pan. Pour in the lemon juice and water. Add the parsley. Simmer till sugar is dissolved.
Mix the flour and brandy together.

Stir the lemon juice mixture pouring the brandy flour mixture. Now whisking vigorously, no lumps, to thicken the sauce about 8-10 minutes. Serve with chicken, pork, or fish. I served with haddock nuggets. I hope you enjoy.
